nodes.label: Calculator Buttons (=, AC, Up, Down)
nodes.rationale: Push buttons: '=' on GPIO1, AC on GPIO14, Up on GPIO21, Down on GPIO47; other leg to GND rail (active-low).

nodes.label: 2.13in E-Paper Display
nodes.rationale: SPI pinout: VCC->3V3, GND->GND, DIN->GPIO3, CLK->GPIO42, CS->GPIO41, DC->GPIO40, RST->GPIO39, BUSY->GPIO38.

nodes.label: Image Preprocessing (illumination flattening / contrast)
nodes.rationale: Removes vignetting/uneven light so problem text is readable before being sent for solving.

nodes.label: Preview / Focus / Flip-Mirror Settings
nodes.rationale: Guide says the preview check decides final orientation; Focus number used to find best distance.

nodes.label: Breadboard Wiring Diagram (exact, camera up)
nodes.rationale: Top-down view with 17 numbered wires; legend says bold labels are the ones to read, faint grey labels belong to the other board end and should be ignored.

nodes.label: Breadboard Wiring Diagram (real orientation, USB away)
nodes.norm_label: breadboard wiring diagram (real orientation, usb away)
nodes.rationale: Same circuit redrawn rotated to match the physical bench: USB ports away from viewer, row 1 nearest; MEDIUM board on left, LONG on right.

nodes.label: Breadboard Wiring Diagram (top, USB toward you)
nodes.norm_label: breadboard wiring diagram (top, usb toward you)
nodes.rationale: Same circuit with row 1 at far end and USB ports toward viewer; notes '-' rail = GND.

nodes.label: Camera Capture Before/After Enhancement
nodes.rationale: Top: raw capture with dark vignette/uneven lighting and faint text; bottom: flattened, contrast-normalized version with crisp text. Test problems: '2x + 7 = 15 find x' and 'v = sqrt(2 g h), h = 5.0 m'.

nodes.label: How To Hold Device Guide
nodes.rationale: Hold long breadboard up-and-down the page so writing runs across the camera's wide side (more pixels per letter); if text appears vertical in preview, rotate 90 degrees. Camera 20-30 cm above page, flat page, good light; upside-down/mirrored OK or use Flip/Mirror setting.
